scope: No product fixtures, workers or full suites executed by this inventory audit. No source/test/stage mutation or holdout reading. Only this report is newly written.

algorithms.assertion_ast_sha256: sha256(json.dumps([ast.dump(n, include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(file_bytes)) if isinstance(n, ast.Assert)], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode())
algorithms.assertion_count: Literal ast.Assert nodes in each complete test file; parameterized collected cases are separate counts. Embedded strings are not counted as file-level assert nodes.

commands.meaning: Discovery lists five acceptance-named test files, but one is baseline-tracked.

commands.command: git diff --name-status 8f61ae5f68c0846d5149aceb4df55c69263c9df2 -- src pyproject.toml tests examples
commands.limitation: Tracked diff alone excludes untracked additions; the full git-baseline vs rg path/byte inventory below is authoritative.

commands.command: git status --short -- src pyproject.toml tests examples

old_acceptance_matrix.exclusion_basis: Exact baseline git ls-tree membership, not a filename pattern. Its collected cases and assertions are not added to the four new files.

completion.stdout_storage: Complete parsed JSON stdout is stored below without omitting any source/test manifest row.

static_audit.result: All 278 source/build and 457 prior tests remain byte exact; every Python AST also matches. No added/removed source path. Exactly four new tests and seven example Python files.

collection.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src:tests:. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 -m pytest --collect-only -q tests/test_acceptance_sorting.py tests/test_acceptance_compression.py tests/test_acceptance_policy_review.py tests/test_acceptance_product.py
collection.meaning: Actual pytest collect-only output, not inferred function count or a successful test run. No acceptance scenario is run merely by importing its plugin.

testing_exporter_review.static_observation: The session fixture calls run_scenario for the four private projects, then writes actual collected run/trace/timing/database data to that project's acceptance-report.json and registers its exact SHA/size. pytest_sessionfinish exports only captured report descriptors. No fixture is executed by this audit; no fresh product result is claimed here.
testing_exporter_review.separation: This static audit recognizes the exporter in e3e5d909 but does not replace root's actual acceptance execution evidence or manufacture reports from expected outcomes.

verification_command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path('docs/evidence/2026-09-11-v1-07-source-inventory-review.json')
r=json.loads(p.read_text()); data=r['static_audit']['parsed_actual_stdout']
def sha(raw): return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
for group in ('sources','old_tests'):
 for name,item in data[group].items():
  raw=pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes()
  assert sha(raw)==item['sha256'],name
  assert raw==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',data['baseline']+':'+name]),name
  if name.endswith('.py'):
   assert sha(ast.dump(ast.parse(raw),include_attributes=False).encode())==item['ast_sha256'],name
for group in ('new_tests','examples'):
 for name,item in data[group].items():
  raw=pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes(); tree=ast.parse(raw)
  assert sha(raw)==item['sha256'],name
  assert sha(ast.dump(tree,include_attributes=False).encode())==item['ast_sha256'],name
  if group=='new_tests':
   a=[ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert)]
   assert len(a)==item['literal_assert_count'],name
   assert sha(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode())==item['assert_ast_sha256'],name
nodes=[line for line in r['collection']['output'].splitlines() if line.startswith('tests/') and '::' in line]
assert len(nodes)==70 and len(set(nodes))==70
assert not any('test_acceptance_matrix.py' in line for line in nodes)
assert r['collection']['exit_code']==0 and '70 tests collected in 0.34s' in r['collection']['output']
assert data['counts']=={'source_and_build_files':278,'old_test_files':457,'old_python_tests':457,'new_test_files':4,'new_literal_asserts':147,'example_python_files':7}
assert not data['mismatches'] and not data['source_added'] and not data['source_removed']
print(json.dumps({'baseline_byte_exact':735,'new_tests':4,'collected_cases':70,'literal_asserts':147,'example_files':7,'old_acceptance_matrix_excluded':True},sort_keys=True))
PY
